help.title: How roles and permissions work
help.intro: Here you decide what each role can do. Check a permission and that role has it; uncheck it and it no longer does.
help.howBody: Each row is an action and each column a role. A checkmark means that role has the permission. Permissions marked as sensitive are worth a second look.
help.scopeIntro: Some permissions (the ones showing an adjust button) also define which data they apply to:
help.scopeOwnExample: Only their own: for example, just their own tickets or tasks.
help.scopeAreaExample: Their area: the data of the people in their department.
help.scopeNote: Checking one of these permissions applies the most cautious scope; you can adjust it with the adjust button next to the checkbox.
help.appliesBody: The change is for the whole role: everyone with that role sees it once their session updates (on reload or when returning to the window). Your own session does not change unless you have that role.
help.catalogBody: In the Catalog tab you create, edit and activate/deactivate permissions. An inactive permission cannot be granted and does not apply to anyone.

catalog.title: Permission catalog
catalog.subtitle: Create, edit and activate the system permissions. They are never deleted, only deactivated.
